# Bark texture attribution

`bark-color.jpg` and `bark-normal.jpg` are adapted, recompressed copies of
`Bark004_1K-JPG_Color.jpg` and `Bark004_1K-JPG_NormalGL.jpg` distributed in
Daniel Greenheck's EZ-Tree repository:

https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree/tree/main/src/app/public/textures/bark/Bark004_1K-JPG

The repository's texture attribution identifies the original source as
ambientCG Bark004, released under CC0 1.0 Universal:

- Source: https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Bark004
- Texture attribution: https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree/blob/main/src/app/public/textures/LICENSE.md
- License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The painted foliage atlases, mineral/lichen/moss surface shaders, cloud
textures, clay and timber treatments in the current refinement are generated
by this project. Earlier MIT-licensed EZ-Tree oak and ash images remain with
their original license for the first version and compatibility helpers.
